title: IELTS Vocabulary Practice - IELTS Vocabulary - Academic Synonyms
subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The overuse of antibiotics can have a **detrimental** effect on human health. What is the closest synonym for 'detrimental'?
questions.explain: 'Detrimental' means tending to cause harm. 'Harmful' is the closest synonym.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: To reduce traffic congestion, the city council plans to **implement** a new public transport system.
questions.explain: To 'implement' means to put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The government needs to take **substantial** measures to combat climate change.
questions.explain: 'Substantial' means of considerable importance, size, or worth; synonymous with 'significant'.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: It is **inevitable** that technology will change the way we work in the future.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: Students must learn to **allocate** their time effectively during the exam.
questions.explain: 'Allocate' means to distribute (resources or duties) for a particular purpose.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The invention of the internet has had a **profound** impact on communication.
questions.explain: 'Profound' means very great or intense; having or showing great knowledge or insight.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The team conducted a **meticulous** investigation into the cause of the accident.
questions.explain: 'Meticulous' means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The solution he proposed was **pragmatic** rather than theoretical.
questions.explain: 'Pragmatic' means dealing with things sensibly and realistically; practical.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: Environmental laws should be strictly **enforced** to protect wildlife.
questions.explain: To 'enforce' implies compelling observance of a law. 'Imposed' is the closest in meaning regarding applying rules strictly.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: Good communication is an **integral** part of any successful relationship.
questions.explain: 'Integral' means necessary to make a whole complete; essential or fundamental.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: There are several **distinct** advantages to living in the countryside.
questions.explain: 'Distinct' means recognizably different in nature from something else of a similar type; clear.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary
